title: Close a restricted planar receiver using established matchgate algorithms
statement: The supplied embedding and cyclic order permit exact signed contraction of empirical Pfaffian interfaces, with a relative normalization certificate.

evidence.quote: # A complete planar receiver for learned ferromagnetic interfaces
# Independent audit of the planar receiver
# Uniform response learning and stable composition in ferromagnetic environments

requires: Retain original N1719 general positive Pfaffian-moment law with odd moments zero, ordered boundary and IID FULL-boundary observations; that original TV-only theorem does NOT require nonnegative even moments. NEW relative-interface extension additionally requires ALL EVEN moments nonnegative. W>=0 must have NONNEGATIVE Fourier coefficients and Z=E_P W>0, e.g. ferromagnetic couplings, consistent nonnegative fields or hard equality. No opposing fields/mixed-sign conditioning. Isolated records, exact model/order promise, calibrated known assembly and repeated occurrences are inputs, not learned/physically earned.
Planar/cofacial receiver interface as stated in family limitations; physical isolated zero-field ferromagnetic blocks and known rational factors 1+a xy,0<=a<=1.
provides: Explicit rational matchgate synthesis/closure and FKT/sign/normalization use established algorithms. Empirical factors may be signed. Prefix probes with mixed algebraic values are computation, not a physical mixed-sign conditioning guarantee.

Relative partition is normalized by UNKNOWN isolated block partitions and uniform environment measure; known powers of2 convert conventions. Hidden bulk partition functions and absolute free energies are not acquired.
assumptions: Original improper boundary-law sampler/evaluator is unchanged and does not learn hidden bulk. Relative error certificate is not automatically an efficient arbitrary contraction/sampler. Planar receiver requires a supplied planar factor-graph disk embedding, correct cyclic block-port order, zero-field known environment and DISTINCT COFACIAL outer output spins with consistent fields. Nonplanar extension requires true factors from finite hidden zero-field FERROMAGNETIC planar blocks (windability witness), not merely arbitrary nonnegative Pfaffian laws; it supplies RELATIVE PARTITION and COARSE 0/1 CURRENTS, NOT physical spin sampling. Clipping empirical factors does NOT preserve windability or establish empirical-chain mixing. Unknown isolated block partition functions/bulk free energies remain unknown. No general opposing-field/antiferromagnetic/infinite-volume theorem, instrument, demonstrated practical advantage or priority. Established Pfaffian/matchgate/FKT/winding and ferromagnetic algorithms are credited same-factor baselines.
costs: Let D=sum absolute pair errors, eta=exp(D)-1. Under admitted W, weighted L1<=Z eta, |Z_A/Z-1|<=eta, normalized signed L1<=2eta/(1-eta), positive-prefix repair TV<=eta/(1-eta). One training event supports all admitted adaptive queries WITHIN total D budget, summing errors PER BLOCK OCCURRENCE. No promise of one fixed summary for unbounded assemblies. Relative product-field learner: m=choose(k,2),h=epsilon/(32m),N>=2h^-2 log(2m/alpha),O(k^4 epsilon^-2 log(k/alpha)) samples, k^2 logN storage, k^4 rational ops/output plus query encoding. Activities lambda>=1 use t=(lambda-1)/(lambda+1),prefactor product((lambda+1)/2); binary activity/field arithmetic paid, no free exp(huge binary field). 0/1 coins direct,capped coins/positive-mass fallback and bad-event nonpositive-root fallback charged.

M=sum choose(k_b,2) over occurrences; each distinct nontrivial block N>=2(32M/epsilon)^2 log(2M/alpha),total<=B*N. Polynomial graph/interface/rational-bit cost,coefficient growth paid; summary reuse counted per occurrence.
contract.units: Source-local rates,energies,TV/half-diamond and counting conventions; no automatic conversion.
